meta.name: cheat-learn-from
meta.description: 从对标账号导入 script + 数据 → 拆 pattern + 派生 base rubric 信号 → 写到 benchmark.md / script_patterns.md / rubric_notes.md。**这是工具最早期信号的来源**——cold-start 用户没自己历史时全靠对标，发过历史的用户也建议至少 1 个对标做 sanity check。触发词："学这个账号"/"拆这几个对标视频"/"learn from"/"导入对标账号"/"找对标"。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对标账号拆解模式并生成分析文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做内容运营需要快速学习对标账号的脚本和模式。
copy.tagline_en: Import competitor accounts, extract patterns, and generate analysis docs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run content operations and need to quickly learn from competitor accounts.

howto.what: 装上后，当你提供对标账号的视频脚本和数据，Claude 会分析其内容模式、表现规律，并生成一份报告，包含脚本结构、选题方向、以及哪些因素可能影响视频表现。
howto.when: 当你提到“学这个账号”、“拆这几个对标视频”、“learn from”、“导入对标账号”、“找对标”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 学这个账号，帮我拆一下它的视频模式。
say.note: Claude 会引导你提供视频脚本和数据，然后分析模式。

say.text: 拆这几个对标视频，看看它们为什么火。
say.note: Claude 会要求你提供至少3条样本，然后拆解共性。

say.text: 导入对标账号，帮我做初始信号。
say.note: Claude 会检查当前状态，然后引导你导入数据。

howto.what_en: When you provide scripts and performance data from a benchmark account, Claude analyzes content patterns and performance drivers, then generates a report covering script structure, topic direction, and which factors may affect video performance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "learn from this account", "analyze these benchmark videos", "learn from", "import benchmark account", or "find benchmark".

say_en.text: Learn from this account, break down its video patterns.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to provide scripts and data, then analyze patterns.

say_en.text: Analyze these benchmark videos, see why they are popular.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for at least 3 samples, then extract commonalities.

say_en.text: Import benchmark account, help me build initial signals.
say_en.note: Claude will check current state, then guide you through data import.
